newsitem.title: RUSSIA: No takers at auction of Russian oil shares.
newsitem.headline: No takers at auction of Russian oil shares.

text.p: There were no takers at an auction on Monday of 4.7 percent of the preferred shares of AO Nizhnevartovskneftegaz and 3.3 percent of ordinary shares in AO Megionneftegazgeologiya, an official of the organiser of the auction said on Tuesday.
Sergei Andreyev, deputy head of the cash auctions department at the Federal Securities Corporation, told Reuters the corporation did not plan to offer the shares again soon.
The corporation offered 861,786 Nizhnevartovskneftegaz shares with a face value of 1,000 roubles at a starting price of 20,000 roubles per share at a cash auction on December 2.
Nizhnevartovskneftegaz is the main production unit of Tyumenskaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya (Tyumen Oil Company).
It also offered 826,672 Megionneftegazgeologiya shares with a face value of 10 roubles at a starting price of 320 roubles.
Megionneftegazgeologiya shares were first offered at an auction on March 27 and failed to attract any bidders then too.
Megionneftegazgeologiya is an exploration and production units of Russian-Belarus oil company Slavneft.
